rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: events and censored samples counted with reverse-KM median follow-up before the model, a Cox model Surv(time, event) ~ scale(score) + condition with the score continuous and standardized, HR per SD with 95% CI, scaled Schoenfeld PH check with stratification or time-varying remedy, and KM tertile curves explicitly demoted to illustration. QC on the blind VST with PCA, distance heatmap and library sizes coloured by condition and event, plus a stated no-silent-removal policy, is appropriate for a single-batch cohort; filterByExpr and TMM logCPM feed a rank-based UCell/singscore score with the count of the 20 genes present reported. Minor gaps: the p-value is Wald rather than likelihood ratio, the reference level of condition is not named, and no alpha is stated for the survival test; the BH mention is vacuous for a single signature. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report step covers versions, seeds, events-per-variable, and the design caveats.
